name: WE3DS: An RGB-D Image Dataset for Semantic Segmentation in Agriculture
description: WE3DS is an open-access multi-class RGB-D image benchmark designed for semantic segmentation in early-stage crop farming, developed by researchers at the University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna (BOKU). It features 2,568 densely annotated RGB-D images combining high-resolution color imagery with calibrated distance and depth maps captured under outdoor field conditions. The dataset provides pixel-level ground truth masks separating soil, 7 crop species (sugar beet, maize, sunflower, soybean, etc.), and 10 weed species, establishing a foundation for 3D agricultural vision and precision robotic spraying.
